background_story: Cuteness was a playful seal who lived in a cozy little cove surrounded by rocky shores. She loved to spend her days swimming in the ocean, chasing schools of fish and playing with the seaweed that swayed back and forth in the currents. But Cuteness' favorite thing to do was to frolic in the foam that formed on the surface of the waves. She would dive and splash, sending the foam flying in all directions, and then pop her head out of the water, grinning from ear to ear. The other seals would laugh and join in, and soon the whole cove would be filled with the sound of their joyful barks and the sight of foam-covered fur. Cuteness was the happiest seal in the sea, and her love of foam brought joy to all those around her.
